record.rationale: React DOM platform code binds existing canonical source model/view and shared Sfx contracts;it does not claim to translate a native VCL implementation file.
responsibilities: Task0V5WR6 connects the production Calc route to actual ScDocument,ScViewData and ScDocShell owners through shared SfxObjectShell,SfxUndoManager,SfxInterface,SfxViewFrame,dispatcher and command bindings. Controlled React presenters reuse Writer toolbar styles,Tailwind,Lucide and global fonts. The supported slice includes plain scalar/native local-A1 input,recalculation,cancel,selection,name-box navigation,sheet append/switch,typed token-valued undo/redo and bounded browser viewport projection. Compiled formula adoption retains code errors in history;sheet deletion ends formula subscriptions and renumbers source cells. One real model owns cells;browser state contains transient input/geometry only. This is a bounded editable workspace,not full Calc/native parity.

Task2BTWEE connects Calc native OpenFromCalc26204,SaveAs5502 and ExportTo5829 Sfx slots to actual ODS workflows and the shared Writer-style file dialog. Current input commits before file focus;primary autosave flushes before open/copy/import;computer imports use existing ODS candidate loading and collision-resolved browser identity;named copies and browser opens use actual primary IO. Shell Export uses a separate medium and leaves primary identity,modified state,generation and undo-save position unchanged. Shared CommandMenuBar and CommandButton render consumed native File/Edit placements and normalized source labels/shortcuts. Open dialogs make background Calc chrome/grid inert and restore actual grid focus on close. Native slot/placement/resource identities are preserved for consumed commands;this is not complete native menu/UI parity.

TaskFKYDT8 ports ScTabView SelectNextTab and SetTabNo sheet grouping from tabview3.cxx and SelectAllTables/DeselectAllTables from tabview2.cxx over real ScViewData/ScMarkData. Native WrapNextPrevSheetTab defaults true. Existing per-sheet cursor state survives navigation;normal selection retains a partial group on already-selected target sheets and collapses an all-selected group. Native Sfx slots26543,26544,26561,26562,26361,26365 use original operation/state boundaries. Navigation commits the real input draft first and rejected drafts prevent movement. Source group-only commands do not change model generation,dirty state or history. Shared CommandMenuBar executes real slots and browser Ctrl/Meta+PageUp/PageDown plus tab-arrow navigation use the same dispatcher. Hidden/alternate sheets,reference editing,drawing/window services and full native parity remain unported.

Task1J8SQQ connects native JumpToTable/SID_CURRENTTAB26042 and one-based UInt16 Nr to actual Calc sheet view ownership. The asynchronous menu path uses the existing shared SfxDialogController,actual document sheet names and native selected-name result semantics. ScGoToTabDlg retains native ordered single selection,initial active sheet,case-sensitive untrimmed substring mask,selection clearing after filter rebuild,double-click acceptance,empty acceptance with no movement and cancellation. Shared Writer DialogHeader and office-dialog styles render the original entry/list/OK/Cancel/Help composition;Help stays disabled because its service is unported. Pending input must commit before opening;modal background is inert and file/page accelerators are suppressed;session closure cancels the request before destroying the model. This is not hidden-sheet/reference/VCL service parity or full Calc UI completion.

TaskYDAWMM repairs actual browser accessibility defects exposed by task10 axe acceptance. Shared top-level CommandMenuBar controls retain their native HTML buttons,existing focus/keyboard/dispatch state machine and visual styling while exposing the required menuitem role. The shared Writer/Calc document title gains h1 semantics with identical text sizing and line height. Calc row/column/corner headers now contain their native selection buttons within proper header elements;corner accessible text and a valid status container complete the grid/chrome semantics. Tests migrate queries to the real menu items and native header buttons,not compatibility aliases or audit exclusions. Native command/cell/selection/input ownership is unchanged. Actual foundation/launcher axe checks and all three Writer dialog geometry viewports pass;full native UI/accessibility service parity remains unclaimed.

TaskQXFX41 ports original ScInputMode NONE0 TYPE1 TABLE2 TOP3 and bounded ScInputHandler mode predicates/toggle at native source boundaries. Browser scalar input shares one draft:TYPE arrows commit/move,TABLE and TOP keep caret navigation. Original SID_SETINPUTMODE26552 and F2 use the same shared-menu dispatcher;TYPE/TABLE toggles preserve draft/history,TOP commits before TABLE and rejected input retains mode/error. GetMode is a read-only browser projection of eMode,not an upstream method. EditEngine,protection,formula reference selection,autocomplete and VCL synchronization remain unported;no full native input parity is claimed.

TaskC5HB8X generates complete pinned sheettab.xml14commands/3separators and native PopupLabel/dialog-suffix projections through shared Writer parser/catalog tooling;451Calc commands remain source-hashed with11top menus and17explicit save-policy dispositions. Actual framework CommandPopupMenu is reused for pointer,ContextMenu and ShiftF10 with shared focus,disabled selection,outside dismissal and geometry. Source ScTabControl SwitchToPageId already-selected return preserves canonical active sheet/group;unselected requests commit supported input and select one target;blank-strip requests retain selection. Native ScInputHandler bFormulaMode/mbEditingExistingContent and StartsLikeFormula predicate distinguish new plus/minus/equals input from existing content. Explicit browser UpdateInputState/ResetInputState projections supply the actual draft/lifecycle without pretending to implement EditEngine or full UpdateFormulaMode. Formula/modal requests are rejected. Existing native SelectAll/Deselect slots execute;unported Insert/Remove/Rename/format/event services remain disabled. Full VCL TabBar current-page state,protection/reference highlighting,EditEngine and whole Calc parity remain unported.

Renders the current Calc editing slice using shared Writer office header,menus,complete visible source standard toolbar with common icons,popup and file dialogs. Native Sfx state owns availability; no fake unsupported command handlers. Full formatting toolbar and whole Calc UI remain unported.

Task98VCB0 mounts the complete pinned native formatobjectbar cell-context resource using actual shared Writer selectors,format glyphs,icons and styles. Source-visible unported formatting commands are disabled through real Sfx state;unknown font name/height remain blank. No fake formatting slots,document attributes or defaults are introduced.

TaskZXWXQ8 connects original no-argument SelectRow/SelectColumn slots26548/26547 to normal-grid ScTabView MarkRows/MarkColumns over actual ScViewData/ScMarkData. Existing simple selection endpoints expand to full axis extents;unmarked selection uses current normal cursor. Cursor and selected sheets remain;selection alone changes neither cells,dirty state nor history. Existing browser input owner commits or rejects pending drafts before selection and publishes real changes. Original ShiftSpace selects rows;column selection uses CtrlSpace on nonMac and AltSpace on Mac,only from the actual grid,not nested editors,composition or modal input. Actual shared Writer menus/resources/dispatch remain reused. Native reference-mode,end-block/window callbacks,parameterized Col/Row/Modifier automation and full native UI/core parity remain unverified.

TaskZXWXQ8 also projects the original InitBlockMode start to the existing browser anchor independently of the active cell,so subsequent shift extension uses the selected axis origin. No additional model or native window service is fabricated.

TaskGKVVR7 connects source standard automatic row-height arithmetic and genuine compressed geometry/flags to current FontHeight UI and attribute Undo/Redo. Original contiguous pool defaults extend through ATTR_MARGIN143. Standard uniform-script unwrapped/unrotated rows use native 256-twip startup minimum,23-twip correction,margin/emphasis and pixel-change conditions. Selected sheets retain one original shared context. React uses actual row segments and bounded physical scrolling; ODS row styles apply to real sheet storage. Device-based initialization/script scanning,rich/wrapped/rotated/merged layout,drawing/hidden rows and standalone height dialogs remain unported. Nonstandard represented attribute profiles decline adjustment;unrepresented foreign layout properties,mixed-script text and device layout remain unverified. Writer primary saving/no-recovery/visible-content policy is retained; broad parity remains unverified.

Task1KGJBF binds browser accelerator configuration from the same generated resources used by menus into the native SfxInterface metadata. Calc reuses the shared browser key mapping and active dispatcher rather than a separate character shortcut switch. Pinned unxwnt configuration values are selected before the existing suite Ctrl/Meta browser alias;macosx-only MOD3 values are not flattened into bare keys. Core standalone slot definitions remain available without a host resolver. Primary/secondary and module/global precedence are source-based;document/custom accelerator configuration and native OS-specific command-key service parity remain unverified.

Task9SF7RJ connects actual shared Writer/SVX color palettes to Calc color10017/background10186 commands,real native color/brush items and sparse selection/history. SfxObjectShell owns recent NamedColor copies and original ColorsChanged notifications;Calc uses that same broadcaster identity. The native broadcaster role is consumed without claiming the unported full SfxShell command/lifecycle class. Original toolbox defaults and names are retained at the browser binding. Native pool defaults continue contiguously through background148,including source system-following number-format language. Actual ODS uses text color/automatic and table-cell background/transparency property groups over shared handlers. Bounded task9SF7RJ acceptance:Calc363cases and related11891cases pass with source-matched raw S/B/F/L100;all21browser cases pass across the original19-case run and corrected1280/390color scenarios. Full native configuration/view services remain unported;fillColor consumes explicit ambient values from the actual plain browser view. No broad parity flags are promoted.

TaskQMVA57 connects native 200-twip indentation,width caps,alignment coercion,filtered working marks and ScUndoIndent to the existing shared Writer toolbar. Actual row-height/manual flags and independent hidden/filtered segments drive native height/hide/show requests,geometry documents,keyboard skipping,compressed grid projection and ODS. The common ScMetricInputDlg accepts original dialog/current/default/unit/digits/range inputs for both axes. Shared XMLMeasurePropHdl preserves original signed scalar saturation,Any assignment and typed extraction;Calc indentation uses original signed16 HMM and UInt16 twip boundaries. Default-view unprotected/unmerged scalar cells only;optimal/device sizing,global undo enablement,UNO service/argument transform graphs,protection,drawing,outline,alternate views and complete native parity remain unverified. Existing primary save/open/no-recovery policies remain. Only related module tests run between all-app checkpoint40 and planned checkpoint50.

TaskFZA8S9 ports original column range emptiness,occupancy and bounded last-row queries;table/document connected-area expansion and shrinking retain source order,diagonals,includeOld/onlyDown and allocated-column clamping. Table construction now uses actual INITIALCOLCOUNT=1. SelectAll5723 honors SelectRangeBeforeAll=true;SelectData26551,shared Writer menus,Ctrl/Meta+A,keypad multiply,platform Space accelerators and direct whole-sheet corner use actual native marks. Cursor,sheet membership,content generation,dirty state and history remain unchanged by selection. Native rich-edit,reference,device/protection and alternate-view services remain unported. Native cached column-iterator hints are omitted as a lookup optimization;the original uncached occupancy overload reads the same real typed store. Existing Writer browser save/open deviations remain.

TaskY1NRHK connects original hidden Deselect26549 and ShiftBackspace to the actual normal-grid ScTabView Unmark state effects:old cursor resets only when marked;real marks clear,cursor and sheet membership remain;the existing browser movement anchor follows original same-position InitOwnBlockMode. Full MoveCursorAbs device/SelectionEngine/reference services remain explicitly unported,without facades. Shared source-generated catalog metadata supplies Undo Selection and its native accelerator without adding a visible menu/toolbar placement. Grid cells/labels suppress DOM text selection declaratively while the actual inline input explicitly retains native text selection;no global Selection mutation is used. Escape remains distinct from Deselect and nested input/menu/modal/composition ownership is preserved. No document/history or browser IO/recovery policy changes;complete native/browser parity remains unverified.

TaskY1NRHK final keyboard route uses the shared canonical event adapter and the active Sfx shortcut table;disabled or reassigned ShiftBackspace is honored. The key-only slot fallback uses the same canonical native Shift+BACKSPACE identity. Source default,unbound,reassigned,consumed-event,modifier and nested-editor cases are covered with actual frame/shell owners.

TaskY1NRHK actual Chromium found that synchronous dialog-close focus ran while the grid was still inert. The workbench restores its real grid in a React layout effect after committed modal removal and inert release,for file,metric and sheet dialogs;immediate callback focus attempts are removed. No timer,global Selection mutation or native window facade is introduced.

TaskSRFT0T implements original ScViewOptions19boolean fields/defaults/copy and genuine document/view value boundaries;object modes,color,drawing-grid aggregate,configuration/window services and full equality remain explicitly unported. Native View Headers26242 and Show Formulas26250 accept slot bools or invert;headers initially change only the view,formula copies the entire represented view options into the document. Grid25018 ignores arguments,creates selected tab-data slots,changes only current-sheet bShowGrid and marks the document modified without adding history or committing input. Genuine shared Writer View menus/Sfx bindings render native checked states;header offsets and scroll geometry disappear,implicit grid lines hide while real cell frames remain,formula output reads source before cached errors. Shared quote-key canonicalization consumes original QUOTELEFT accelerator. Browser redraw/invalidation projects native paint/resize callbacks;no fake window/modificator/configuration service or alternate model. Native view-settings XML persistence and complete parity remain unported;Writer IO/no-recovery deviations remain.

Task5678C0 connects original ScColBar/ScRowBar size/hide methods and hdrcont tracking arithmetic to actual ScViewFunc,marks,document and undo. UInt16 conversion,min10pixels,selected disjoint spans,grouped sheets,negative-size hide,threshold2 and release+2screen-offset are retained. React stores temporary guide coordinates only and uses shared VCL window tracking moved from Writer. Active editing prohibits sizing. The existing96CSSdpi scale is supplied explicitly by the browser,not claimed as a native device default. Device optimum,double-click autofit,metric drag tooltip,physical RTL,zoom,split/alternate views,protection and complete native windows remain unported. No broad parity or save/open/recovery policy change.

Block74 work in progress connects actual RPN outer-function adjacency,directional AutoSum search with the original20-cell cutoff,sum-of-sums,relative range token output,and nonempty selected-block totals through native SetFormulaOperation. Original StartFormula preserves content-dependent UTF16 selection instead of replacing every cell with a bare equals;browser caret projection runs after controlled render and retains shared Writer styling. NeedHeight queries traverse actual attribute runs and default-column tails. The normal enabled-recording/default-view profile retains real value owners and source manual-calculation behavior. Native tasks76/74 now connect ordinary empty-block EnterBlock/PasteFromClip and compiled grouped formula copies through the actual clipboard/context/store owners and one shared Sfx Copy Undo action. Named database/autofilter collections,SUBTOTAL,filtered/nondefault paste,nondefault undo/alternate-view/device services remain unported. Browser availability admits represented ordinary blocks and native disjoint-mark fallback,while disabling contexts requiring missing services. Broad contract/default/behavior parity remains unverified.

Task77 adds normal unmerged local-reference mouse input using actual ScInputHandler selected UTF16 text,ScModule ordered dispatch,ScViewData reference start/end and ScTabView block/function-set owners. Browser formula pointing precedes Commit and preserves the edit origin;ordinary cell dragging retains the active anchor while headers move their native cursor endpoint. Shift extends;Ctrl adds/subtracts native ScMarkData/ScMultiSel selections. This is bounded source-backed foundation work,not full Calc parity. Merged cells,fill/transfer/move,protected/alternate/split views,reference dialogs,external/3D/matrix calculation,EditEngine and complete VCL painting remain unported. React binds the sole controller draft and DOM caret,uses shared Writer/VCL pointer capture and styling,and paints reference rectangles separately from ordinary native marks. Browser viewport/physical scroll mapping and repeat capture are platform adaptations;desktop scroll acceleration and complete range-finder parsing remain unported.

Final74 browser regression exposed a real input-focus race after ODS open:controlled layout re-applied the native end caret after browser select-all,so replacement appended to existing text. Source ScTextWnd::GetFocus delegates to WeldEditView without resetting selection. The presenter now records actual browser-owned TOP focus for that layout transaction and preserves its selection;programmatic native Formula/AutoSum/reference focus still projects native caret/ranges. Already-TOP programmatic focus does not restart native input. No timer,heuristic text rewrite or second editor model is introduced. Actual DOM select-all replacement/history regression and existing native argument/reference selection tests pass.
